description: This file defines translations for multiple languages and adds a tab in the Allure report UI with associated layout logic.

classes.name: TreeLayout
classes.description: A component class responsible for rendering a hierarchical layout of the test packages within the Allure report.

methods.name: addTranslation
methods.description: Adds language-specific translations for the 'Packages' tab.

methods.name: addTab
methods.description: Creates a new tab in the Allure report with specified title, icon, route, and entry action.

methods.name: onEnter
methods.description: Callback function invoked when the 'packages' tab is entered, initializing the TreeLayout component with parameters.
